q: Describe a situation where you had a disagreement with a colleague. What did you do?
a:
In my previous experience, I had a disagreement with a colleague about how to prioritize tasks during a busy period. We both had to manage several responsibilities at the same time, but we had different ideas about what to do first.

Instead of arguing, I stayed calm and did not react emotionally. First, I listened carefully to understand my colleague’s point of view. I believe that many conflicts and disagreements happen because of misunderstandings or poor communication.

After listening to his point of view, I shared my thoughts in a respectful way. Then, I suggested that we focus on the most urgent and important tasks first and support each other to manage the workload more effectively.

After listening to each other respectfully, we reached a compromise and worked together more effectively. This experience taught me that clear communication, respect, and teamwork are very important, especially during disagreements or conflicts.
